lines.japanese: Mobile Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game
lines.english: Mobile Massively Multiplayer Online Role Playing Game

lines.japanese:
大規模ネットワークアールピージーの携帯コンテンツ版のこと。
　依然として強い人気を誇る、大規模ネットゲームだが、近年では携帯版も勢い
が強い。
lines.english: A mobile version of a massively multiplayer online RPG. Massively multiplayer online games remain enormously popular, and in recent years their mobile versions have been gaining ground as well.
